title: Free My TV / CleanYourTV device profile
description: The other half of the contract: what a TV *is*. Facts measured on one device — which packages exist, what each one is allowed to become, how its inputs are wired. The payload (tvconfig) is what the person chose; this is what the hardware allows. A runtime that does not know a fate refuses to act on it and says so, instead of treating it as keep.

spec.description: Contract version. Adding an optional key keeps it; changing a key's meaning makes it 2.

kind.description: Which document this is. A runtime that does not know a kind refuses the file and says so.

id.description: Short, stable id: brand plus device, lowercase, dashes. The payload may point at it.

name.description: Human name for the settings screen and the phone companion.

brand.description: ro.product.brand, as the TV reports it.

model.description: ro.product.model, as the TV reports it (often the marketing name, sometimes just "Smart TV").

device.description: ro.product.device: the name the runtime matches on when the fingerprint changed after an update.

android.description: API level measured on the device (30 = Android 11).

fingerprint.description: ro.build.fingerprint. Exact match wins over device; it changes with every firmware update.

tested.description: Date the profile was measured ON THIS DEVICE, not the date the file was written.

evidence.description: Where the data came from: session, commit, commands. One line, enough to redo the measurement.

display.description: The UI budget. A 720p panel and 1 GB of RAM decide what the home screen may draw.

stock_home.description: The factory home package, recorded before anything replaces it. off_after_handover exists so this only goes off once ours is up.

input_service.description: The TvInputService that owns the inputs on this TV.

input_picker.description: Intent action the TV answers to open its own input picker, e.g. com.android.tv.action.VIEW_INPUTS.

quirks.description: What this TV does differently. Machine-readable ids, explained in the capability matrix.

packages.description: Only packages measured on this device. Absent from the TV means absent from here; a runtime never touches a package that is not listed.

pkg.description: Android package name, as pm list packages prints it.

fate.description: off: disable in the mode. off_after_handover: only once our home is up. keep: leave alone. never: refuse, even if another list says otherwise.

why.description: Short, checkable reason. Required for off: a package nobody can justify is a package that comes back.

installed.description: Evidence of the day it was measured, not live state: the runtime always reads pm list packages.

disabled.description: Evidence of the day it was measured, not live state.
